turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi! I think we're neighbours. I've just moved in next door.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Oh, hi! Welcome to the building. When did you move in?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: On Saturday. There are boxes everywhere! How long have you lived here?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: For about three years. It's a quiet building, and the neighbours are really friendly. Where did you live before?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: In the city centre. It was fun, but so noisy.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I know what you mean. I used to live there too, and I couldn't sleep! I think this area is much better.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That's good to hear. Is there a gym near here?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, there's one near the metro station. It's small, but it's cheap. Do you like running? The park five minutes away is great for that.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I do! I run at the weekends.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Me too. And I think the bakery on the corner is the best in the area. You should try their bread.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Well, I'll let you get back to your boxes. Let me know if you need anything.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That's very kind. Nice to meet you!
